title: Signature Global Rosalia — 2BHK Apartment in Sector 84

scenes.title: Welcoming Family Foyer
scenes.description: A compact, practical entrance foyer with a warm wooden front door bearing the family nameplate and a Ganesha motif. A wooden shoe rack, a child's scooter, and a 'HOME' key holder set a lived-in tone, while the floor opens directly onto the bright open-plan living and dining area to one side and a short passage to the bedrooms and bathroom on the other.
scenes.caption: Lived-in foyer with shoe rack
scenes.narration_script: As you step in through the family's front door, you're standing in the apartment's foyer — notice the shoe rack and the little scooter that hint at a busy family home. To your left the space flows straight into the sunlit living and dining area, while a short passage on your right leads back toward the bedrooms and bath. Let's head into the living room.

scenes.title: Sunlit Open-Plan Living Room
scenes.description: A bright, open-plan living and dining space anchored by an L-shaped sage-green sectional, a low wooden coffee table, and a wall-mounted TV on a light-wood console. Light ceramic tile flooring stretches to a curtained balcony with glass sliding doors and a city view, and a dining table sits beside the kitchen, making this the central hub that connects the foyer, kitchen, master bedroom, bathroom, and balcony.
scenes.caption: Sage sectional, balcony-lit hub
scenes.narration_script: Welcome to the heart of the home — an open-plan living and dining room. The sage-green sectional and wooden coffee table face the TV wall, and just beyond the dining table the glass doors open to a road-facing balcony. From here you can reach almost everywhere: the kitchen past the dining area, the master bedroom and bathroom through the doorways on this wall, and the foyer behind you. Take your pick.

scenes.title: Functional Family Kitchen
scenes.description: A practical L-shaped kitchen with a granite countertop, a gas hob under a stainless chimney, a steel sink below a grilled window, and light-wood modular cabinetry with glass-front upper units. A stainless fridge and a small granite breakfast bar with two stools sit near the open passage that leads back to the living and dining area, with a service door to the utility area alongside.
scenes.caption: Granite counters, breakfast-bar kitchen
scenes.narration_script: Here's the family kitchen — compact but well organised, with granite counters, a gas hob beneath the chimney, and plenty of glass-front storage. Notice the little breakfast bar with stools by the fridge, and the window over the sink that pulls in daylight. The open passage behind you leads straight back to the living and dining area.

scenes.title: Restful Master Bedroom
scenes.description: A spacious master bedroom with a large double bed, a light-wood wardrobe, and a dresser topped with family photo frames. A wide curtained window floods the room with daylight and frames a city view, and an attached bathroom opens off one corner while the main door leads back out to the living and dining area.
scenes.caption: Bright master with attached bath
scenes.narration_script: This is the master bedroom — generously sized, with a comfortable double bed, a light-wood wardrobe, and a dresser dressed with family photos. The big curtained window brings in plenty of morning light and a view over the neighbourhood. The doorway here takes you back to the living and dining area, your hub for the rest of the home.

scenes.title: Clean Modern Bathroom
scenes.description: A bright, well-kept bathroom finished in large beige tiles, with a vessel basin on a wood-and-granite vanity, a wall-hung toilet with a health faucet, and a curved glass-enclosed shower with a rain showerhead. Towels and toiletries give it a comfortable everyday feel, and the single wooden door opens back onto the living-area passage.
scenes.caption: Vessel sink, glass shower bath
scenes.narration_script: Step into the family bathroom — crisp beige tiles, a neat vessel basin on a granite-topped vanity, and a curved glass shower with a rain head in the corner. It's a practical, well-cared-for space. When you're ready, the door leads back out to the living area.

scenes.title: Road-Facing City Balcony
scenes.description: An open road-facing balcony with a metal railing and a sweeping view toward New Gurgaon's residential high-rises through a soft summer haze. A wicker armchair and a glass-topped side table make a quiet corner, while a clothes-drying rack and potted plants line the wall, and glass sliding doors connect it back to the living area.
scenes.caption: City-view balcony with seating
scenes.narration_script: And here we are out on the balcony — road-facing, with a wide-open view across the New Gurgaon skyline. There's a cosy wicker chair and a little glass table for your morning tea, plus space along the wall for drying laundry and a few plants. When you're done taking in the view, slide the doors and step back into the living room.
